_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/config.local.json and fill in real values. Never commit real hosts here. The skill runs without this file, but it skips the sibling-repository check and falls back to the org managed policy for internal identifiers.

repos._comment_root: Absolute path to the directory that holds your checkouts.
repos._comment_services: Deployable services. Used to widen a usage grep.
repos._comment_shared: Libraries other repos depend on. A bump here is checked against siblings.

internal._comment_orgs: Git orgs that host first-party code. Exempt from cooldown and pinning. Matched by URL, never by package name.
internal._comment_hosts: Private package registries that serve first-party packages. Also matched by URL.
